output: html_document

```{r}

#==============================================================================
# MODULE 03 — Single-cell RNA-seq normalization, clustering, and DEA
#==============================================================================

# Purpose:
#   Process the QC-filtered GSE298688 single-cell RNA-seq Seurat object
#   generated in Module 02. Normalize RNA expression, identify highly
#   variable genes, scale expression, perform PCA, evaluate potential
#   sample-associated effects, construct a nearest-neighbor graph, cluster
#   cells, generate UMAP embeddings, characterize cluster composition,
#   perform cluster-level differential expression analysis, generate marker
#   visualizations, and save the processed Seurat object for downstream
#   cell-type annotation.
#
# Input:
#   data/processed/single_cell/
#     GSE298688_QC_filtered_seurat.rds
#
# Output object:
#   data/processed/single_cell/
#     GSE298688_processed_clustered_seurat.rds
#
# Output tables:
#   results/single_cell/processing/
#   results/single_cell/cluster_markers/
#
# Output figures:
#   figures/single_cell/processing/
#   figures/single_cell/cluster_markers/
#   figures/single_cell/cluster_markers/volcano_plots/
#
# Processing parameters:
#   Normalization:       LogNormalize
#   Scale factor:        10,000
#   Variable features:   2,000
#   PCA components:      50
#   Dimensions used:     1:30
#   Clustering:          Louvain/Seurat graph clustering
#   Resolution:          0.5
#   UMAP dimensions:     1:30
#
# Differential expression:
#   Test:                Wilcoxon rank-sum test
#   Minimum percentage:  0.10
#   log2FC threshold:    0.25
#   Adjusted P threshold used for visualization: 0.05
#
# Notes:
#   - Harmony was evaluated during workflow development but was not retained
#     for the final analysis because the uncorrected embedding showed adequate
#     mixing across samples.
#   - Because sample identity is partially associated with experimental
#     condition, unnecessary batch correction could remove biological signal.
#   - Cluster-level DEA compares each Seurat cluster with all remaining cells.
#   - Treatment-level DEA is biologically distinct and is not performed here.
#   - The processed object generated here is used in Module 04 for SingleR
#     cell-type annotation.
#==============================================================================


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load required packages
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(SeuratObject)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(here)
})


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Reproducibility settings
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

set.seed(1234)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Define analysis parameters
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

normalization_scale_factor <- 10000

number_variable_features <- 2000

number_pcs <- 50

analysis_dimensions <- 1:30

clustering_resolution <- 0.5

marker_min_pct <- 0.10

marker_log2fc_threshold <- 0.25

adjusted_p_threshold <- 0.05

top_markers_per_cluster <- 10


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Define repository paths
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

processed_directory <- here::here(
  "data",
  "processed",
  "single_cell"
)


processing_results_directory <- here::here(
  "results",
  "single_cell",
  "processing"
)


marker_results_directory <- here::here(
  "results",
  "single_cell",
  "cluster_markers"
)


processing_figure_directory <- here::here(
  "figures",
  "single_cell",
  "processing"
)


marker_figure_directory <- here::here(
  "figures",
  "single_cell",
  "cluster_markers"
)


volcano_figure_directory <- here::here(
  "figures",
  "single_cell",
  "cluster_markers",
  "volcano_plots"
)


directories_to_create <- c(
  processed_directory,
  processing_results_directory,
  marker_results_directory,
  processing_figure_directory,
  marker_figure_directory,
  volcano_figure_directory
)


for (directory in directories_to_create) {

  dir.create(
    directory,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )
}


input_file <- file.path(
  processed_directory,
  "GSE298688_QC_filtered_seurat.rds"
)


processed_object_file <- file.path(
  processed_directory,
  "GSE298688_processed_clustered_seurat.rds"
)


cat(
  "\n============================================================\n",
  "MODULE 03 — Single-cell normalization, clustering, and DEA\n",
  "============================================================\n",
  "Repository root:       ", here::here(), "\n",
  "Input object:          ", input_file, "\n",
  "Processed data:        ", processed_directory, "\n",
  "Processing results:    ", processing_results_directory, "\n",
  "Marker results:        ", marker_results_directory, "\n",
  "Processing figures:    ", processing_figure_directory, "\n",
  "Marker figures:        ", marker_figure_directory, "\n",
  "============================================================\n\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Validate and load Module 02 output
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (!file.exists(input_file)) {

  stop(
    "Module 02 output was not found:\n",
    input_file,
    "\n\nRun 02_seurat_qc_filtering.Rmd before Module 03."
  )
}


cat(
  "Loading QC-filtered single-cell Seurat object...\n"
)


single_cell <- readRDS(
  input_file
)


if (!inherits(single_cell, "Seurat")) {

  stop(
    "Loaded input file is not a valid Seurat object."
  )
}


if (!"RNA" %in% Seurat::Assays(single_cell)) {

  stop(
    "RNA assay was not found in the input Seurat object."
  )
}


Seurat::DefaultAssay(
  single_cell
) <- "RNA"


required_metadata <- c(
  "sample",
  "condition",
  "nCount_RNA",
  "nFeature_RNA",
  "percent.mt"
)


missing_metadata <- setdiff(
  required_metadata,
  colnames(
    single_cell@meta.data
  )
)


if (length(missing_metadata) > 0) {

  stop(
    "Required metadata column(s) missing from input object:\n",
    paste(
      missing_metadata,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}


cat(
  "Object loaded successfully:\n",
  "  Genes:   ", nrow(single_cell), "\n",
  "  Cells:   ", ncol(single_cell), "\n",
  "  Samples: ",
  length(
    unique(
      single_cell$sample
    )
  ),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


cat(
  "\nCells by sample:\n"
)


print(
  table(
    single_cell$sample
  )
)


cat(
  "\nCells by condition:\n"
)


print(
  table(
    single_cell$condition
  )
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Inspect and join Seurat v5 RNA assay layers
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Inspecting RNA assay layers\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)


rna_layers_before <- SeuratObject::Layers(
  single_cell[["RNA"]]
)


cat(
  "RNA layers before joining:\n"
)


print(
  rna_layers_before
)


if (length(rna_layers_before) > 1) {

  cat(
    "\nMultiple RNA assay layers detected.\n",
    "Joining layers before normalization and differential expression...\n",
    sep = ""
  )


  single_cell <- SeuratObject::JoinLayers(
    single_cell,
    assay = "RNA"
  )
}


rna_layers_after <- SeuratObject::Layers(
  single_cell[["RNA"]]
)


cat(
  "\nRNA layers available after layer check:\n"
)


print(
  rna_layers_after
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Normalize RNA expression
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Normalizing RNA expression\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)


single_cell <- Seurat::NormalizeData(
  single_cell,
  assay = "RNA",
  normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
  scale.factor = normalization_scale_factor,
  verbose = FALSE
)


cat(
  "RNA normalization completed successfully.\n"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Identify highly variable genes
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Identifying highly variable genes\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)


single_cell <- Seurat::FindVariableFeatures(
  single_cell,
  assay = "RNA",
  selection.method = "vst",
  nfeatures = number_variable_features,
  verbose = FALSE
)


number_variable_features_identified <- length(
  Seurat::VariableFeatures(
    single_cell
  )
)


if (number_variable_features_identified == 0) {

  stop(
    "No highly variable genes were identified."
  )
}


cat(
  "Variable features identified: ",
  number_variable_features_identified,
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Generate variable-feature plot
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable_feature_plot <- Seurat::VariableFeaturePlot(
  single_cell
) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Highly Variable Genes"
  )


print(
  variable_feature_plot
)


variable_feature_plot_file <- file.path(
  processing_figure_directory,
  "GSE298688_variable_features.png"
)


ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = variable_feature_plot_file,
  plot = variable_feature_plot,
  width = 7,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Scale highly variable genes
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Scaling highly variable genes\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)


single_cell <- Seurat::ScaleData(
  single_cell,
  assay = "RNA",
  features = Seurat::VariableFeatures(
    single_cell
  ),
  verbose = FALSE
)


cat(
  "Variable features scaled successfully.\n"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 11. Perform principal component analysis
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Performing principal component analysis\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)


single_cell <- Seurat::RunPCA(
  single_cell,
  assay = "RNA",
  features = Seurat::VariableFeatures(
    single_cell
  ),
  npcs = number_pcs,
  verbose = FALSE
)


if (!"pca" %in% names(
  single_cell@reductions
)) {

  stop(
    "PCA reduction was not created successfully."
  )
}


cat(
  "PCA completed successfully.\n",
  "Principal components calculated: ",
  ncol(
    Seurat::Embeddings(
      single_cell,
      reduction = "pca"
    )
  ),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 12. Generate PCA elbow plot
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

elbow_plot <- Seurat::ElbowPlot(
  single_cell,
  ndims = number_pcs
) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "PCA Elbow Plot"
  )


print(
  elbow_plot
)


elbow_plot_file <- file.path(
  processing_figure_directory,
  "GSE298688_PCA_elbow_plot.png"
)


ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = elbow_plot_file,
  plot = elbow_plot,
  width = 7,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 13. Assess sample-associated effects in PCA space
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Assessing sample-associated effects in PCA space\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)


pca_sample_plot <- Seurat::DimPlot(
  single_cell,
  reduction = "pca",
  group.by = "sample"
) +
  ggplot2::ggtitle(
    "PCA by Sample"
  )


pca_condition_plot <- Seurat::DimPlot(
  single_cell,
  reduction = "pca",
  group.by = "condition"
) +
  ggplot2::ggtitle(
    "PCA by Experimental Condition"
  )


print(
  pca_sample_plot
)


print(
  pca_condition_plot
)


pca_sample_plot_file <- file.path(
  processing_figure_directory,
  "GSE298688_PCA_by_sample.png"
)


pca_condition_plot_file <- file.path(
  processing_figure_directory,
  "GSE298688_PCA_by_condition.png"
)


ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = pca_sample_plot_file,
  plot = pca_sample_plot,
  width = 7,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)


ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = pca_condition_plot_file,
  plot = pca_condition_plot,
  width = 7,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 14. Generate uncorrected UMAP for batch-effect assessment
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Generating uncorrected UMAP for batch assessment\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)


single_cell <- Seurat::RunUMAP(
  single_cell,
  reduction = "pca",
  dims = analysis_dimensions,
  reduction.name = "umap_uncorrected",
  reduction.key = "UMAPuncorrected_",
  seed.use = 1234,
  verbose = FALSE
)


uncorrected_umap_sample <- Seurat::DimPlot(
  single_cell,
  reduction = "umap_uncorrected",
  group.by = "sample"
) +
  ggplot2::ggtitle(
    "Uncorrected UMAP by Sample"
  )


uncorrected_umap_condition <- Seurat::DimPlot(
  single_cell,
  reduction = "umap_uncorrected",
  group.by = "condition"
) +
  ggplot2::ggtitle(
    "Uncorrected UMAP by Experimental Condition"
  )


print(
  uncorrected_umap_sample
)


print(
  uncorrected_umap_condition
)


uncorrected_sample_file <- file.path(
  processing_figure_directory,
  "GSE298688_uncorrected_UMAP_by_sample.png"
)


uncorrected_condition_file <- file.path(
  processing_figure_directory,
  "GSE298688_uncorrected_UMAP_by_condition.png"
)


ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = uncorrected_sample_file,
  plot = uncorrected_umap_sample,
  width = 7,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)


ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = uncorrected_condition_file,
  plot = uncorrected_umap_condition,
  width = 7,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 15. Optional Harmony batch-correction assessment
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Harmony was evaluated during development of this workflow.
#
# The uncorrected PCA and UMAP showed adequate mixing of cells from C2_S2,
# N1_S3, and N2_S4 within major transcriptional populations. Harmony
# correction was therefore not used for final graph construction or
# clustering.
#
# Because sample identity is partially associated with experimental condition
# in this dataset, unnecessary correction could remove biological variation.
#
# Users adapting this protocol to another dataset may evaluate Harmony or
# another integration strategy if strong technical sample separation is
# observed.
#
# Example:
#
# suppressPackageStartupMessages({
#   library(harmony)
# })
#
# single_cell <- harmony::RunHarmony(
#   object = single_cell,
#   group.by.vars = "sample",
#   reduction.use = "pca",
#   dims.use = analysis_dimensions,
#   verbose = FALSE
# )
#
# single_cell <- Seurat::RunUMAP(
#   single_cell,
#   reduction = "harmony",
#   dims = analysis_dimensions,
#   reduction.name = "umap_harmony",
#   reduction.key = "UMAPharmony_",
#   seed.use = 1234,
#   verbose = FALSE
# )


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 16. Construct nearest-neighbor graph
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Constructing nearest-neighbor graph\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)


single_cell <- Seurat::FindNeighbors(
  single_cell,
  reduction = "pca",
  dims = analysis_dimensions,
  verbose = FALSE
)


cat(
  "Nearest-neighbor graph constructed successfully.\n"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 17. Cluster cells
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Clustering cells\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)


single_cell <- Seurat::FindClusters(
  single_cell,
  resolution = clustering_resolution,
  random.seed = 1234,
  verbose = FALSE
)


if (!"seurat_clusters" %in% colnames(
  single_cell@meta.data
)) {

  stop(
    "Seurat clustering did not generate a seurat_clusters column."
  )
}


number_clusters <- length(
  unique(
    single_cell$seurat_clusters
  )
)


cat(
  "Clustering completed successfully.\n",
  "Clusters identified: ",
  number_clusters,
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


cat(
  "\nCells per cluster:\n"
)


print(
  table(
    single_cell$seurat_clusters
  )
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 18. Generate final UMAP embedding
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Generating final UMAP embedding\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)


single_cell <- Seurat::RunUMAP(
  single_cell,
  reduction = "pca",
  dims = analysis_dimensions,
  reduction.name = "umap",
  reduction.key = "UMAP_",
  seed.use = 1234,
  verbose = FALSE
)


if (!"umap" %in% names(
  single_cell@reductions
)) {

  stop(
    "Final UMAP reduction was not created successfully."
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 19. Visualize final clustering
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cluster_umap <- Seurat::DimPlot(
  single_cell,
  reduction = "umap",
  group.by = "seurat_clusters",
  label = TRUE,
  repel = TRUE
) +
  ggplot2::ggtitle(
    "Seurat Clusters"
  )


sample_umap <- Seurat::DimPlot(
  single_cell,
  reduction = "umap",
  group.by = "sample"
) +
  ggplot2::ggtitle(
    "UMAP by Sample"
  )


condition_umap <- Seurat::DimPlot(
  single_cell,
  reduction = "umap",
  group.by = "condition"
) +
  ggplot2::ggtitle(
    "UMAP by Experimental Condition"
  )


print(
  cluster_umap
)


print(
  sample_umap
)


print(
  condition_umap
)


cluster_umap_file <- file.path(
  processing_figure_directory,
  "GSE298688_UMAP_clusters.png"
)


sample_umap_file <- file.path(
  processing_figure_directory,
  "GSE298688_UMAP_by_sample.png"
)


condition_umap_file <- file.path(
  processing_figure_directory,
  "GSE298688_UMAP_by_condition.png"
)


ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = cluster_umap_file,
  plot = cluster_umap,
  width = 7,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)


ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = sample_umap_file,
  plot = sample_umap,
  width = 7,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)


ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = condition_umap_file,
  plot = condition_umap,
  width = 7,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 20. Save combined UMAP overview
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

umap_overview <- cluster_umap |
  sample_umap |
  condition_umap


print(
  umap_overview
)


umap_overview_file <- file.path(
  processing_figure_directory,
  "GSE298688_UMAP_overview.png"
)


ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = umap_overview_file,
  plot = umap_overview,
  width = 18,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 21. Examine cluster composition across samples
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Examining cluster composition across samples\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)


cluster_counts <- single_cell@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::count(
    seurat_clusters,
    sample,
    condition,
    name = "n_cells"
  )


cluster_proportions <- cluster_counts %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    seurat_clusters
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    percent_of_cluster =
      100 *
      n_cells /
      sum(
        n_cells
      )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()


cat(
  "\nCluster composition:\n"
)


print(
  cluster_proportions
)


cluster_composition_file <- file.path(
  processing_results_directory,
  "GSE298688_cluster_sample_composition.csv"
)


utils::write.csv(
  cluster_proportions,
  cluster_composition_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 22. Generate cluster-composition plot
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cluster_composition_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  cluster_proportions,
  ggplot2::aes(
    x = seurat_clusters,
    y = percent_of_cluster,
    fill = sample
  )
) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(
    width = 0.8
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Sample Composition of Seurat Clusters",
    x = "Seurat cluster",
    y = "Cells within cluster (%)",
    fill = "Sample"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_classic(
    base_size = 12
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(
      face = "bold"
    )
  )


print(
  cluster_composition_plot
)


cluster_composition_plot_file <- file.path(
  processing_figure_directory,
  "GSE298688_cluster_sample_composition.png"
)


ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = cluster_composition_plot_file,
  plot = cluster_composition_plot,
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 23. Prepare cluster identities for differential expression
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n============================================================\n",
  "Cluster-level differential expression analysis\n",
  "============================================================\n",
  "Clusters: ", number_clusters, "\n",
  "Test: Wilcoxon rank-sum\n",
  "Minimum detection fraction: ", marker_min_pct, "\n",
  "log2FC testing threshold: ", marker_log2fc_threshold, "\n",
  "============================================================\n",
  sep = ""
)


Seurat::DefaultAssay(
  single_cell
) <- "RNA"


Seurat::Idents(
  single_cell
) <- "seurat_clusters"


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 24. Confirm RNA layers are joined before DEA
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

rna_layers_dea <- SeuratObject::Layers(
  single_cell[["RNA"]]
)


if (
  sum(
    grepl(
      "^data",
      rna_layers_dea
    )
  ) > 1
) {

  cat(
    "\nMultiple normalized RNA data layers detected before DEA.\n",
    "Joining RNA layers...\n",
    sep = ""
  )


  single_cell <- SeuratObject::JoinLayers(
    single_cell,
    assay = "RNA"
  )
}


cat(
  "\nRNA layers used for differential expression:\n"
)


print(
  SeuratObject::Layers(
    single_cell[["RNA"]]
  )
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 25. Identify cluster marker genes
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\nRunning FindAllMarkers()...\n"
)


cluster_markers <- Seurat::FindAllMarkers(
  object = single_cell,
  assay = "RNA",
  only.pos = FALSE,
  min.pct = marker_min_pct,
  logfc.threshold = marker_log2fc_threshold,
  test.use = "wilcox",
  verbose = FALSE
)


if (nrow(cluster_markers) == 0) {

  stop(
    "No cluster marker genes were identified."
  )
}


if (!"gene" %in% colnames(
  cluster_markers
)) {

  cluster_markers$gene <- rownames(
    cluster_markers
  )
}


cat(
  "Differential expression completed successfully.\n",
  "Marker results identified: ",
  nrow(cluster_markers),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 26. Save complete differential-expression results
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cluster_marker_file <- file.path(
  marker_results_directory,
  "GSE298688_cluster_markers_all.csv"
)


utils::write.csv(
  cluster_markers,
  cluster_marker_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 27. Summarize marker genes by cluster
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

marker_summary <- cluster_markers %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    cluster
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    total_markers = dplyr::n(),

    positive_markers = sum(
      avg_log2FC > 0 &
        p_val_adj < adjusted_p_threshold,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    negative_markers = sum(
      avg_log2FC < 0 &
        p_val_adj < adjusted_p_threshold,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )


cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Marker summary by cluster\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)


print(
  marker_summary
)


marker_summary_file <- file.path(
  marker_results_directory,
  "GSE298688_cluster_marker_summary.csv"
)


utils::write.csv(
  marker_summary,
  marker_summary_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 28. Select top positive markers for each cluster
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

top_markers <- cluster_markers %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(
      p_val_adj
    ),
    p_val_adj < adjusted_p_threshold,
    avg_log2FC > 0
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    cluster
  ) %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(
    order_by = avg_log2FC,
    n = top_markers_per_cluster,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()


if (nrow(top_markers) == 0) {

  stop(
    "No significant positive cluster markers were available for visualization."
  )
}


top_marker_file <- file.path(
  marker_results_directory,
  "GSE298688_top10_cluster_markers.csv"
)


utils::write.csv(
  top_markers,
  top_marker_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)


cat(
  "\nTop positive markers selected for ",
  length(
    unique(
      top_markers$cluster
    )
  ),
  " clusters.\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 29. Scale selected marker genes for heatmap visualization
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

heatmap_genes <- unique(
  top_markers$gene
)


heatmap_genes <- intersect(
  heatmap_genes,
  rownames(
    single_cell
  )
)


if (length(heatmap_genes) == 0) {

  stop(
    "None of the selected marker genes were found in the Seurat object."
  )
}


single_cell <- Seurat::ScaleData(
  single_cell,
  assay = "RNA",
  features = heatmap_genes,
  verbose = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 30. Generate cluster-marker heatmap
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cluster_heatmap <- Seurat::DoHeatmap(
  single_cell,
  features = heatmap_genes,
  group.by = "seurat_clusters",
  size = 3
) +
  Seurat::NoLegend()


print(
  cluster_heatmap
)


cluster_heatmap_file <- file.path(
  marker_figure_directory,
  "GSE298688_top10_cluster_marker_heatmap.png"
)


ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = cluster_heatmap_file,
  plot = cluster_heatmap,
  width = 14,
  height = 12,
  dpi = 300
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 31. Generate volcano plots for each cluster
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Generating cluster volcano plots\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)


cluster_ids <- sort(
  unique(
    cluster_markers$cluster
  )
)


volcano_files <- character(
  length(
    cluster_ids
  )
)


for (i in seq_along(
  cluster_ids
)) {

  cluster_id <- cluster_ids[i]


  cluster_de <- cluster_markers %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      cluster == cluster_id
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(

      significance = dplyr::case_when(

        !is.na(
          p_val_adj
        ) &
          p_val_adj < adjusted_p_threshold &
          avg_log2FC >= marker_log2fc_threshold ~
          "Upregulated",

        !is.na(
          p_val_adj
        ) &
          p_val_adj < adjusted_p_threshold &
          avg_log2FC <= -marker_log2fc_threshold ~
          "Downregulated",

        TRUE ~
          "Not significant"
      ),

      plot_p = pmax(
        p_val_adj,
        .Machine$double.xmin,
        na.rm = FALSE
      ),

      neg_log10_p = -log10(
        plot_p
      )
    )


  volcano_labels <- cluster_de %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      significance == "Upregulated"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::slice_max(
      order_by = avg_log2FC,
      n = top_markers_per_cluster,
      with_ties = FALSE
    )


  volcano_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    cluster_de,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = avg_log2FC,
      y = neg_log10_p
    )
  ) +

    ggplot2::geom_point(
      ggplot2::aes(
        color = significance
      ),
      alpha = 0.65,
      size = 1.5
    ) +

    ggplot2::geom_vline(
      xintercept = c(
        -marker_log2fc_threshold,
        marker_log2fc_threshold
      ),
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +

    ggplot2::geom_hline(
      yintercept = -log10(
        adjusted_p_threshold
      ),
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +

    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = volcano_labels,
      ggplot2::aes(
        label = gene
      ),
      size = 3.2,
      box.padding = 0.4,
      point.padding = 0.2,
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      min.segment.length = 0,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +

    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "Upregulated" = "#D73027",
        "Downregulated" = "#4575B4",
        "Not significant" = "grey70"
      )
    ) +

    ggplot2::labs(
      title = paste0(
        "Differential Expression of Seurat Cluster ",
        cluster_id
      ),
      subtitle = "Cluster compared with all remaining cells",
      x = "Average log2 fold change",
      y = expression(
        -log[10](
          "adjusted p-value"
        )
      ),
      color = NULL
    ) +

    ggplot2::theme_classic(
      base_size = 12
    ) +

    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 14
      ),
      plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(
        size = 11,
        color = "grey35"
      ),
      axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(
        face = "bold"
      ),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.justification = "left"
    )


  print(
    volcano_plot
  )


  volcano_file <- file.path(
    volcano_figure_directory,
    paste0(
      "GSE298688_cluster_",
      cluster_id,
      "_volcano.png"
    )
  )


  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = volcano_file,
    plot = volcano_plot,
    width = 7,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 300
  )


  volcano_files[i] <- volcano_file
}


cat(
  "Volcano plots generated: ",
  length(
    volcano_files
  ),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 32. Save analysis parameter table
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

analysis_parameters <- data.frame(

  parameter = c(
    "normalization_method",
    "normalization_scale_factor",
    "variable_features",
    "pca_components",
    "analysis_dimensions",
    "clustering_resolution",
    "batch_correction",
    "marker_test",
    "marker_min_pct",
    "marker_log2fc_threshold",
    "adjusted_p_threshold",
    "top_markers_per_cluster"
  ),

  value = c(
    "LogNormalize",
    normalization_scale_factor,
    number_variable_features,
    number_pcs,
    paste0(
      min(
        analysis_dimensions
      ),
      ":",
      max(
        analysis_dimensions
      )
    ),
    clustering_resolution,
    "None",
    "Wilcoxon",
    marker_min_pct,
    marker_log2fc_threshold,
    adjusted_p_threshold,
    top_markers_per_cluster
  ),

  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)


analysis_parameter_file <- file.path(
  processing_results_directory,
  "GSE298688_processing_parameters.csv"
)


utils::write.csv(
  analysis_parameters,
  analysis_parameter_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 33. Validate final processed Seurat object
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Validating processed Seurat object\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)


if (!inherits(
  single_cell,
  "Seurat"
)) {

  stop(
    "Processed object is not a valid Seurat object."
  )
}


required_reductions <- c(
  "pca",
  "umap_uncorrected",
  "umap"
)


missing_reductions <- setdiff(
  required_reductions,
  names(
    single_cell@reductions
  )
)


if (length(missing_reductions) > 0) {

  stop(
    "Required dimensionality reduction(s) missing:\n",
    paste(
      missing_reductions,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}


if (!"seurat_clusters" %in% colnames(
  single_cell@meta.data
)) {

  stop(
    "seurat_clusters metadata was not found in the processed object."
  )
}


if (length(
  Seurat::VariableFeatures(
    single_cell
  )
) == 0) {

  stop(
    "Variable features were not retained in the processed object."
  )
}


if (anyDuplicated(
  colnames(
    single_cell
  )
) > 0) {

  stop(
    "Duplicated cell barcodes detected in processed object."
  )
}


if (anyDuplicated(
  rownames(
    single_cell
  )
) > 0) {

  stop(
    "Duplicated gene names detected in processed object."
  )
}


cat(
  "Processed Seurat object validation completed successfully.\n"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 34. Save processed Seurat object
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Saving processed Seurat object\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)


saveRDS(
  single_cell,
  processed_object_file
)


if (!file.exists(
  processed_object_file
)) {

  stop(
    "Processed Seurat object was not saved successfully:\n",
    processed_object_file
  )
}


cat(
  "Processed Seurat object saved successfully.\n"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 35. Validate expected Module 03 outputs
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

expected_result_files <- c(
  cluster_composition_file,
  cluster_marker_file,
  marker_summary_file,
  top_marker_file,
  analysis_parameter_file
)


expected_figure_files <- c(
  variable_feature_plot_file,
  elbow_plot_file,
  pca_sample_plot_file,
  pca_condition_plot_file,
  uncorrected_sample_file,
  uncorrected_condition_file,
  cluster_umap_file,
  sample_umap_file,
  condition_umap_file,
  umap_overview_file,
  cluster_composition_plot_file,
  cluster_heatmap_file,
  volcano_files
)


missing_result_files <- expected_result_files[
  !file.exists(
    expected_result_files
  )
]


missing_figure_files <- expected_figure_files[
  !file.exists(
    expected_figure_files
  )
]


if (length(
  missing_result_files
) > 0) {

  stop(
    "One or more expected Module 03 result files were not created:\n",
    paste(
      missing_result_files,
      collapse = "\n"
    )
  )
}


if (length(
  missing_figure_files
) > 0) {

  stop(
    "One or more expected Module 03 figure files were not created:\n",
    paste(
      missing_figure_files,
      collapse = "\n"
    )
  )
}


cat(
  "All expected Module 03 output files were created successfully.\n"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 36. Final module summary
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n============================================================\n",
  "MODULE 03 COMPLETE — Single-cell normalization, clustering, and DEA\n",
  "============================================================\n",
  "Cells:                 ", ncol(single_cell), "\n",
  "Genes:                 ", nrow(single_cell), "\n",
  "Variable genes:        ",
  length(
    Seurat::VariableFeatures(
      single_cell
    )
  ),
  "\n",
  "PCA components:        ", number_pcs, "\n",
  "Dimensions used:       ",
  min(
    analysis_dimensions
  ),
  ":",
  max(
    analysis_dimensions
  ),
  "\n",
  "Clustering resolution: ", clustering_resolution, "\n",
  "Clusters identified:   ", number_clusters, "\n",
  "Batch correction:      Not used\n",
  "Marker results:        ", nrow(cluster_markers), "\n",
  "Volcano plots:         ", length(volcano_files), "\n",
  "\n",
  "Primary output:\n",
  "  ", processed_object_file, "\n",
  "\n",
  "Processing tables:\n",
  "  ", processing_results_directory, "\n",
  "\n",
  "Marker tables:\n",
  "  ", marker_results_directory, "\n",
  "\n",
  "Processing figures:\n",
  "  ", processing_figure_directory, "\n",
  "\n",
  "Marker figures:\n",
  "  ", marker_figure_directory, "\n",
  "\n",
  "Volcano plots:\n",
  "  ", volcano_figure_directory, "\n",
  "\n",
  "Next module:\n",
  "  04_seurat_singleR.Rmd\n",
  "============================================================\n\n",
  sep = ""
)
```
